signature: A stepped warm-earth wet-line running full-bleed across the board, dividing a navy wet field from a light dry field — the tape mark a tech leaves where the water stopped. RA's 'sweep' motion signature rendered static.
signature_rule: The line sits at 59.4% of height; step depth is 7.2% of height; the riser stands one 56px gutter clear of the hook's longest line rather than at a fixed column, so it never collides with the type. Below ~400px tall the step FLATTENS to a straight line, because a step under 24px reads as a rendering artefact rather than a mark. Below ~320px tall the line hides entirely and the board falls back to a flat navy field with the hook reversed out of it.
